summary: Isabella Bank Corp filed an 8-K on September 21, 2026, reporting that Grand River Commerce shareholders approved the June 11, 2026 merger agreement at a special meeting held September 18, 2026. The transaction is a two-step merger: Merger Sub merges into Grand River, then Grand River merges into Isabella, followed by Grand River Bank merging into Isabella Bank. No price per share, premium, or break fee was disclosed in this excerpt. Closing is expected in Q4 2026, subject to regulatory approvals and customary conditions. Watch regulatory approval timing and any closing delays.
